title: SCP catalogue configuration: the `catalog:` block and the catalog-owned part of `github.sources[].discovery`
description: Hand-written (the matcher is a one-key mapping, which a generator cannot express). cmd/scp grafts `properties` under /properties/catalog of the root schema and `$defs/discovery` next to github's own discovery keys with allOf + unevaluatedProperties:false. Semantic rules (uniqueness, default_repo membership, reserved words) are NOT expressible here: they are the C/W/R rules of Config.Validate and Lint.

ungrouped.description: What happens to a repository that no group selects: listed without a group (track) or not tracked at all (ignore).

slug_prefix_by_source.description: Slug prefix per source (key `source`) or per source and owner (key `source/owner`). The slug of a repository is prefix + name.

archived_interval.description: 1h..168h. TTL of the per-repository catalog.stats job.

id.description: URL segment of /groups/{id}. Lower case; unique together with the aliases of every group (case-insensitive).

default_repo.description: GitHub repository name (case-insensitive) of the repository that represents the group; it must be selected by this group's matchers.

sources.description: Restrict the group to these sources; empty or absent = every source.

match.description: A repository is a member when ANY matcher selects it. A repository may be a member of any number of groups.

ref.description: Track this branch instead of each repository's default branch (not covered by the head sweep).

aliases.description: Earlier ids of this group; /groups/{alias} redirects (308) to /groups/{id}.

instance.description: Name of a configured Jenkins instance (integrations.jenkins.instances[].name); its existence is validated by integrations.ValidateGroupDefaults.

matcher.description: Exactly one key. exact, prefix and glob compare the repository NAME case-insensitively and anchored (whole name); regexp is RE2, case-sensitive unless it says (?i), and must match the WHOLE name; topic compares GitHub topics (lower case); catch_all selects everything.

glob.description: Only * (any run, also empty) and ? (one character) are special.

discovery.description: Catalog-owned keys of github.sources[].discovery (github adds mode and org).
